mimi.description: A sweet, bright young female voice for Mimi, a fashionable cartoon kitten who loves the color pink. American English. Warm, cheerful and gentle, like a friendly host of a preschool TV show. Speaks slowly and very clearly for a three-year-old.
mimi.preview_text: Let's make cupcakes! Put in the milk. Two eggs. One, two! What color? Pink! So pretty! Put three hearts on top! Your turn! Great job! Yummy! Thank you!

bebe.description: An energetic, bubbly, high-pitched young female voice for Bebe, a cartoon bunny who loves sweets and is always full of energy. American English. Bouncy and happy, playful, but clear and slow enough for a three-year-old to follow.
bebe.preview_text: Let's make cupcakes! Put in the sugar. Stir, stir, stir! Into the oven! Let's count. One, two, three, four, five! Ding! They're ready! Your turn! Yay! Awesome!

popo.description: A soft, relaxed, easygoing voice for Popo, a gentle cartoon panda who loves to dance. American English. Calm, warm, a little playful and unhurried, with a round friendly tone. Very clear for preschool children.
popo.preview_text: Let's make cupcakes! Put in the milk. Stir, stir, stir! What color? Purple! So pretty! Wow! Beautiful! Your turn! Good job! Yummy! Thank you so much!

narrator.description: A cheerful, youthful cartoon voice for a friendly little sidekick character in a preschool show. American English. Playful, bright and clear, saying short phrases slowly so a three-year-old can copy them.
narrator.preview_text: Here you go! Here you go, Mimi! Here you go, Bebe! Here you go, Popo! Thank you! One, two, three! Yummy! I like pink. Because they're yummy!
